title: Bishop Steps Off
setup: Your a7-pawn is one square from queening and your own bishop is sitting on a8, right in its path.
hint: The bishop must vacate, and it should land somewhere that gives Black no free move to interfere.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bd5+}} clears a8 with check along the a2-g8 diagonal. Black has to answer the check, and none of the answers stops the pawn: after {{Kh8}} or {{Kf8}}, {{a8=Q+}} even promotes with check, and after {{Kh7}} the pawn queens just the same. Vacating with check is the whole point.
